title: 4 Text and 4 Headline
slide_intent: Show a coordinated range of weights and widths, because different reading tasks and programme tones need distinct voices within one family.
strategic_value: The related Text and Headline specimens can let Channel 4 vary emphasis and tone without abandoning typographic recognition.
demonstration: A white specimen compares 4 Text in upright and italic weights with 4 Headline in condensed, standard, italic and extended forms; the lists run from Extralight to Black.
practical_value: Compare weight, slant and width as separate choices before selecting a text or show-title treatment.

content_islands.name: 4 Text specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the Text family at left with aligned upright and italic weight lists.

content_islands.name: 4 Headline specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the Headline family at right with parallel condensed, standard, italic and extended weight lists.

content_islands.name: Family labels
content_islands.spec: Keep each family name above its specimen so the roles remain distinguishable.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study says the Headline family was expanded with condensed and extended styles to give show branding tonal flexibility.
reference_purposes.Expression: A white specimen compares 4 Text in upright and italic weights with 4 Headline in condensed, standard, italic and extended forms; the lists run from Extralight to Black.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in parallel family specimens for comparing weight, width and slant.

ingredient.name: 4 Text and 4 Headline families
ingredient.role: Give reading text and programme titles related but distinct voices.
ingredient.application: Compare weight, width and italic treatments before choosing the show or text setting.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2023 case-study specimens. The source explains tonal flexibility; this artwork does not prescribe exact sizes or a mandatory weight for a role.
